records.issue_text: Existing-attendee dedupe at addGuests.handler.ts:76 uses case-sensitive comparison (`guest === attendee.email`), so `A@B.com` is added alongside an existing `a@b.com`
records.rationale: The diff shows `!booking.attendees.some((attendee) => guest === attendee.email)` in addGuests.handler.ts, a case-sensitive comparison. Emails are treated case-insensitively in practice (domains), so `A@B.com` would pass dedupe against existing `a@b.com`, creating a duplicate attendee. No normalization/lowercasing of guest emails occurs in the schema or handler.
